## s15-v07 — argument map

Blind ones, lepers even (apy andhā api kuṣṭhinaḥ). They shine, supreme, ornamented by blazing devotion to Thee (śobhante param uddāmabhavadbhaktivibhūṣaṇāḥ).

### Open
- Swamiji's maxim ad loc: he who is attached to God is beautiful because love for God is charming (s13-v04 twin).
